verdict.line: You lose if Camille lands the level 2 Hookshot all-in before your W is up; you win once Hallowed Mist denies her follow-up and your health-based magic damage scales into her bruiser build.

brief.thesis: Gwen's Hallowed Mist denies Camille the single-target tools she needs to actually kill you — Precision Protocol's empowered auto and the Hextech Ultimatum both require targeting you directly, which fails unless Camille walks into the mist. Meanwhile A Thousand Cuts deals bonus magic damage based on the target's current health, which scales naturally into a max-HP bruiser like Camille. The 50.6% win rate over 816 games and Gwen's measured lane and solo-kill advantage both point the same way: this is a close fight, but the structure favors you.

theirWindow.what: Camille can use E (Hookshot, range 800) to leap off a wall and knock you up on landing before you have Hallowed Mist to hide in. Don't crash the first wave or stand near a wall she can jump from until W is up.

yourWindow.what: With E on its 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown and no gap-closer left, use your own E (Skip 'n Slash) to dash in, get the attack speed and magic on-hit buff, and auto-trade freely — Hallowed Mist is there to bail you out if she tries to answer.

start.why: The 50.5% win rate, 91.4% pick-rate start over 886 games — AP and sustain to survive Camille's early auto-attack poke before your W comes online at level 2.

boots.why: 55.6% win rate over 295 games, the stronger of the two boot options — magic penetration matters more here since every point of your damage is magic and Camille will build some MR.

core.why: First item on the 58.1% win rate, 33.5% pick-rate path — builds your core AP and ability haste to keep E and R cycling.
Second on that same path — spikes your burst right as Camille's health total climbs, feeding A Thousand Cuts harder.
Completes the 58.1% win rate core — raw AP scaling that makes every health-percent tick from your passive hit harder.

situational.when: camille buys lethality and threatens to burst you down with her Q (Precision Protocol) empowered auto
camille is snowballing and you need to survive extended auto-attack trades instead of shredding her MR
the game goes long and you want sustained damage and tankiness over a burst spike

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramps through extended trades and offsets the healing Camille gets from the outer half of her W (Tactical Sweep) — the 50.4% win rate page built around it is the dominant pick at 29.3%.

summoners.why: The highest win rate and by far the most picked combo (51.3% win rate, 66.7% pick rate) — it matches the data's measured solo-kill advantage for Gwen in this matchup, giving you the extra damage to close out early skirmishes.

playing.title: Don't crash waves pre-level 2
playing.detail: Camille's E (Hookshot, range 800) lets her leap off a nearby wall and knock up enemy champions on landing before you have Hallowed Mist to hide behind. Play passive near walls until W is up.

playing.title: Chain E for near-permanent uptime
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash (base cooldown 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s) partially refunds its cooldown if you hit an enemy during the attack speed window it grants, so land a hit every time you use it to keep it almost always available.

playing.title: Drop W the instant she commits
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist only lets enemies target you if they physically enter it — once Camille lands E or walks up to auto-attack, summon W immediately to shut down her Q (Precision Protocol) empowered attack and her ultimate target-lock.

playing.title: Clear with Q, don't duel with it
playing.detail: Snip Snip! hits up to 6 times in a cone (6.5s cooldown at rank 1, down to 3.5s at rank 5) with true damage in the center — use it to clear waves fast and deny Camille's weaker early clear before level 6.

playing.title: Punish after her ultimate is down
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum dashes to and anchors a targeted champion (140/115/90s cooldown at early ranks) — once she's used it and whiffed or landed it on someone else, you have a long window to shove and trade without fear of being locked down.

playing.title: Sidestep the outer edge of her W
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep fires after a delay and the outer half of the cone slows, deals extra damage, and heals Camille — wait out the delay and step away rather than trading through it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoner spells, and all win rates/sample sizes above come from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reads on cooldowns, targeting rules, and trade timing are my own tactical analysis layered on top.
